record_note: Filenames were recorded from the documents supplied by the team. The PDFs are not redistributed in this repository, so SHA-256 fingerprints, page counts and publication years are null here rather than guessed. Run `python -m scripts.build_source_register --pdf-dir <folder>` from the backend once the PDFs are available locally to fill them in. A null field means unverified, not zero and not unknown-by-accident.
bibliography_scope: This register lists the documents consulted for the applications library. It is not an exhaustive bibliography of every citation inside those papers, and no dataset mentioned by a paper has been integrated merely because it was mentioned.
